services.name: Stand Up Paddleboards
services.desc: Stand Up Paddleboarding, or SUP, is the fastest growing water sport and wildly popular choice for our guests. For those seeking to enjoy Lake of the Ozarks while experiencing our beautiful lakefront, paddleboarding is the perfect watersport for you. New to SUP? Even if you’ve never stood on a surfboard before most people find themselves gliding like a pro in minutes. We offer basic instructions that can make anyone feel comfortable. services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Come spend the day on our Sweetwater 26 foot Tritoon, 12 passenger boat for the best boat trip on Lake of the Ozarks. Each of our boats is equipped with a Yamaha 150 HP engine. Customize your boat with tubing, wakeboarding, or even lounge on the lake with one of our aqua mats. Enjoy discounted rates when you book a 4-hour rental up to a full 8-hour day! Multi day (overnight) rentals are available by calling our team (not available through online booking). Wanting to let someone else do the work for you?
